name: Skills
description: Discover agent skills — named bundles of instructions, context, and tools. Pick the action with `command`: 'list' renders the skill index, one '- name — description' line per skill (or null when no skills exist; also usable as a config.context assemble-op); 'read' returns one skill in full. Skills live in workspace directories (w/skills), the venue catalog (v/skills), or content-addressed assets. Read-only — author skills with covia:write or asset:store.

sources.description: Skill sources — directory paths (w/skills, v/skills) or asset refs (a/<hash>). Default: ["w/skills", "v/skills"].

name.description: read only: a skill name from the index, looked up across sources.

ref.description: read only: direct skill address (a/<hash>, v/skills/<x>, w/skills/<x>) — alternative to name.

output.description: list → the skill index text (one '- name — description' line per skill), or null when no skills exist. read → {name, description, body?, tools, context?, path} — body present when the skill has content (a contentless skill is a pure toolset).
